title: AIInferenceOutputEnvelope
description: Standardized response envelope returned by the AI module to the backend.

success.description: True if inference executed without fatal errors; false otherwise.

model_version.description: Semantic identifier of the executing model or heuristic engine.

result.description: Prediction result payload (null if success is false). TODO: FINALIZE AFTER OFFICIAL PROBLEM STATEMENT

prediction.description: Primary predicted class, continuous value, category, or recommendation list.

confidence.description: Calibrated model confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0.

explanation.description: Human-readable or structured explanation of why the prediction was made.

fallback_used.description: Indicates whether the prediction was produced by the fallback heuristic.

error.description: Null on successful inference, populated on error.
